    wire [63:0] SEG_MAP;
    wire [63:0] XLXN_390;

    // Begin internal logic replacement

    // P2S module logic

            shift_reg <= 0;

            shift_counter <= 0;
        end else begin
            shift_counter <= shift_counter + 1;
            shift_reg <= shift_reg >> 1;

    assign seg_clrn = ~rst;
    assign seg_sout = shift_reg[0];

            end
            generate_seg_text = seg_text;
        end
    endfunction

    assign XLXN_390 = generate_seg_text(Hexs, flash, LES, point);
